Questions

Which WageGrid metro has the highest Social workers annual median?

Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA has the highest published OEWS May 2025 annual median for Child, Family, and School Social Workers ($75,280). Among metros with a published median: Seattle $75,280, Chicago $64,790, Austin $58,640. WageGrid does not rank suppressed cells or invent a missing wage.

Which WageGrid metro employs the most Social workers?

Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN has the highest published OEWS May 2025 employment for Child, Family, and School Social Workers (13,550 wage-and-salary workers). Published employment: Chicago 13,550, Seattle 5,540, Austin 1,670. Self-employed workers are excluded.

Where are Social workers most concentrated relative to the national mix?

Chicago has the highest published location quotient (1.19). Published LQs: Chicago 1.19, Seattle 1.05, Austin 0.51.

What is the hourly median for Social workers in each metro?

OEWS May 2025 hourly medians: Austin $28.19; Chicago $31.15; Seattle $36.19. Blank means BLS withheld the estimate.

Does this comparison include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS covers wage-and-salary workers and excludes the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment estimate.

U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. WageGrid is not affiliated with BLS. Blank cells are BLS suppressions, not estimates.
